items: 【Accessories】Includes WOWPC Recovery USB for quick, one-click system restoration, giving you peace of mind against crashes or errors. Also comes with Microsoft Office 2021 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and more), delivering essential tools for work, study, and daily productivity. Together, they keep your device protected, ready, and optimized for maximum efficiency and seamless performance.

【Processor】Powered by AMD Ryzen 5 7530U with 6 cores and 12 threads, delivering strong performance for multitasking, productivity, and smooth everyday computing. Built on advanced 7nm architecture with a base clock of 2.0 GHz and boost up to 4.5 GHz, it offers excellent efficiency and responsiveness. Ideal for business, study, and entertainment, with integrated AMD Radeon Graphics providing crisp, fluid visuals.

【Operating System】Pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro 64-bit, built for business performance, advanced security, and productivity. It features BitLocker encryption, Remote Desktop, Group Policy, and Azure Active Directory integration, making it ideal for professionals and organizations. With a modern interface and support for the latest apps, Windows 11 Pro ensures a smooth, secure, and future-ready experience.

【Key Features】Equipped with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 for fast, reliable connectivity. Includes USB-C, dual USB-A, HDMI 1.4b, RJ-45 Ethernet, and a headphone/microphone combo jack for versatile use. Features a 15.6" Full HD (1920×1080) anti-glare display for clear, comfortable viewing. Comes with a full-size keyboard with numeric keypad and HD webcam for smooth video calls. Durable gray design combines practicality, portability, and modern style — ideal for business, study, and daily work.

【Display】Enjoy a crisp 15.6-inch Full HD (1920×1080) anti-glare display that delivers sharp visuals and vibrant colors for work, study, or entertainment. The wide viewing angles ensure consistent clarity from every position, while the matte finish reduces reflections for comfortable viewing. With 250-nit brightness, it offers clear visibility in various lighting environments — perfect for productivity, streaming, and everyday use.
